body: Is there a way to CC an additional email address on alert notifications without making that person a full user? We have an external auditor who needs to receive certain alerts. I can see the recipient field but not a CC option.

subject: Dashboard filter — dropdown not showing all values
body: The dropdown filter on our main dashboard is only showing 50 values but there should be around 200. Is there a limit on the number of values shown in a filter dropdown? We need our analysts to be able to filter by any of our product categories.

subject: Scheduled export delivering wrong report
body: A scheduled export is delivering the wrong report — it's sending a version from two months ago rather than the current report definition. I've checked the schedule settings and the correct report is selected. Is there a cache issue with scheduled exports?

subject: Dashboard permissions — some users seeing wrong data
body: Two analysts are seeing data they shouldn't have access to on a shared dashboard. We have row-level security configured but it doesn't seem to be applying correctly for these users. This is a data access issue and needs to be looked at urgently. The dropdown filter issue from last month is resolved but now this.

subject: Row-level security not working in report builder either
body: The same row-level security problem from the dashboard is present in the report builder as well. Users are seeing rows they should be restricted from. This is not an isolated widget issue — the RLS configuration itself doesn't seem to be enforced consistently. I need to know the root cause.

subject: RLS fix hasn't held — users still accessing restricted data
body: The row-level security issue we had in June and July is back. The fix applied last month clearly didn't address the root cause. This is the third time I'm raising a data access control problem. I need escalation — a BI analyst should not have to keep chasing the same security issue. Our legal team has been informed.

subject: Report builder crashing on save — losing RLS configuration
body: While trying to re-apply the row-level security configuration the report builder crashed mid-save. Now the report has no RLS rules at all. I'm spending hours on a problem that should have been solved months ago. I expect compensation or a meaningful account credit for the time this has cost us.

subject: RLS seems to be working — monitoring it
body: The latest fix appears to be holding so far. Restricted users are seeing the correct data. I'll monitor for another week before considering this closed. Would appreciate a technical explanation of what was wrong and what changed.

subject: Export not respecting RLS — different problem
body: Separate from the report builder RLS issue — CSV exports don't seem to apply row-level security either. A user exported a report and got rows they can view in the UI but shouldn't in an export. Are exports a separate code path from the viewer? This needs to be treated as a security issue.

subject: Export RLS fix — follow-up on column-level controls
body: The export RLS fix is in. Tested and it looks correct now. Follow-up question: is there column-level security in exports, or only row-level? We have some fields that should be masked for certain user groups regardless of row access.

subject: Report scheduling — timezone handling
body: When I schedule a report to run at 08:00, is that in UTC or local time? We're in Helsinki (EET/EEST) and I want to make sure the report is ready before our morning meeting, not two hours late.

subject: Data connector sync failing since last week — no explanation
body: Our main connector has been failing to sync since February 3rd. I have not received any notification from Kataja about this. I only noticed because reports were showing stale data. Was there an incident? Why wasn't I notified? I need to understand what caused this and how you plan to communicate outages going forward.

subject: API integration breaking repeatedly — same root cause each time
body: Our API integration has broken three times this year — connector issues in February, then two separate API-side problems. Each time we get a fix but no explanation of the root cause and no changes to prevent recurrence. I'm done accepting individual fixes. I need a technical review of our integration and a commitment from your team that this kind of repeated breakage stops. If that's not something you can offer I need to know that too.

subject: API endpoint question
body: Which endpoint should I use for pulling historical export job status? Trying to build an audit log on our side. The docs list a few candidates but it's not clear which is authoritative.

subject: Removing seats before renewal
body: We need to reduce our seat count before the renewal date. What is the process for this and what is the deadline? Also want to confirm there are no penalties for reducing seats mid-cycle.

subject: API — filtering results by date range
body: How do I filter API results by a date range? The docs show a date_from parameter but I'm not getting filtered results — it returns everything regardless of what I pass. Is there additional syntax required or is the parameter name different in the current API version?

subject: API pagination — confirming cursor-based approach
body: Just confirming: is the API pagination cursor-based or offset-based? The docs mention both in different sections and I want to make sure I'm implementing the right approach for a large data pull.

subject: Formula syntax — CASE WHEN equivalent
body: Is there a CASE WHEN or IF/THEN equivalent in the report builder formula language? I want to create a bucketing column based on value ranges. I found examples in the docs but the syntax doesn't seem to be working for nested conditions.

subject: Dashboard not loading — blank screen
body: Main financial dashboard showing a blank screen for me and one colleague. Other dashboards load fine. No error message. Cleared cache and tried a different browser, same result.

subject: Dashboard filter — date picker not working correctly
body: The date picker on a dashboard filter is not respecting fiscal year dates. Our fiscal year starts in April and the 'this year' shortcut defaults to January 1st. Is there a way to configure the fiscal year start in the platform?

subject: YTD calculation — fiscal year not aligned
body: Same fiscal year issue as my dashboard ticket — YTD calculated fields in the report builder are using January as the year start instead of April. Is this a global account setting or does it need to be set per report? We need all time calculations to respect our April fiscal year start.

subject: Export taking longer than usual
body: Our standard monthly export that normally takes a few minutes ran for over an hour before I manually stopped it. It eventually worked when I tried again, but this is the second time in November. Is something going on with export performance?

subject: Export timeout — happening consistently now
body: Export timeouts are now consistent, not intermittent. I raised this earlier in November and it seems to have gotten worse. The report hasn't changed. This is affecting our month-end process. Please look at what changed on your side.

subject: Seat count — who has logged in recently?
body: Can you give me a report or at least a list of which users have logged in during the last 90 days? We're trying to decide whether to reduce seats before renewal and want to identify inactive users. Not sure where to find this in the admin panel.

subject: Year-end connector sync — data gap
body: Running our year-end data pull and there's a gap in the connector sync covering December 28th to 30th. No failed sync status was shown. The data is just missing. We need this data for year-end accounts. Please prioritize — it's the 31st.

subject: Connector sync gaps — happened again in January
body: Another sync gap, this time covering January 2nd and 3rd. The year-end gap issue was supposedly addressed. This is now a pattern. We cannot have silent data gaps in a financial reporting system. What is actually being done to prevent this?

subject: Dashboard calculated totals — discrepancy with source data
body: Dashboard summary totals don't match our source data after the connector sync gaps. The connector gap issue has been ongoing since December. We've had to fall back to manual Excel reconciliation to confirm numbers, which is obviously not the point of having a BI platform. I need to understand when the connector reliability issues will be permanently fixed, not just patched.

subject: API capabilities — complex query support
body: We're evaluating how much we can move to an API-driven workflow rather than relying on the UI. Can the API support multi-step filtered queries with aggregations, or is it limited to direct data pulls? Trying to understand whether the API is mature enough for the kind of reporting logic we need, or if we'd need to build that logic on our side.

subject: API webhook support — what's available?
body: Following up on my API question from January. We're building a more automated reporting pipeline and need to know if the API supports webhooks for data change events or sync completion. If we can trigger downstream processes automatically it would significantly reduce manual steps. Looking for detailed documentation on this.

subject: API integration plan — need to speak to someone technical
body: We've been asking detailed API questions over the past month and getting responses that don't quite address what we need. I'd like to speak directly with a technical person who can assess whether the API architecture can support our use case. We're making decisions about our reporting infrastructure and the API is a key part of that. Please arrange a call.

subject: API still not meeting our needs — looking at alternatives
body: We never got the technical call arranged after my February request. The API questions we raised are still unanswered. We have had connector gaps, export problems, and dashboard discrepancies over the past six months — and now the API isn't delivering what we need for automation either. We are actively evaluating Dashlume as an alternative. I'm raising this here as a formal record. If someone wants to have a real conversation about how Kataja can meet our requirements I'm open to it, but the clock is running.
